description: Round 7 (expressions family, seeds 19001-19015, 30000 cases; the tree of the second performance pass merged with the fuzz-harness fixes, 1cd373e): inside an array or hash literal (also the variadic arguments of dump(), which Twig passes as `...[...]`), the `odd` and `even` tests raise the TypeError of their `%` at an earlier line than PHP (P44). Twig compiles them inline (OddTest, EvenTest: `(node % 2 != 0)`, `(node % 2 == 0)`); PHP's ZEND_MOD takes CG(zend_lineno) as its last operand left it, the literal `2` written right after the node, so the error reports the last debug marker inside the node (the name `s` on line 2), while twig-rs reports the line of the literal or of the node's first token. The `%` operator written out, `divisible by` and the tests outside a literal match. Not from the performance pass: the tree before it (a258816) reports the same lines. Minimised from x19005-00668-logic (1 raw case). Vectors with known_mismatch still differ; the others are controls that must stay identical. Recorded with "isolation": "process".

vectors.note: minimised from x19005-00668-logic (1 raw case; the minimiser dropped every data key); PHP folds `[] ?? s` to `[]` inside the literal, but the `2` after the compiled false branch still sits after its `// line 2`

error.rawMessage: An exception has been thrown during the rendering of a template ("Unsupported operand types: array % int").

known_mismatch.reason: P44: an `odd`/`even` test inside an array literal reports the line its node starts on (or the literal's) instead of the last marker before its `%`. src/lltl/codegen.rs, Codegen::test() (TestKind::Even | TestKind::Odd) emits the literal 2 OddTest/EvenTest write without Codegen::leaf(), so the Mod takes the php_marker the node's compilation left; an uncommitted experiment with self.leaf() after emit_const(Value::Int(2)) made every case of this file match
